name: Shadow Strike
description: A blindingly fast physical strike from the shadows. Low cost, reliable damage — Kaze's bread-and-butter move.

name: Poison Shuriken
description: A shuriken laced with paralytic venom. Deals moderate damage with a high chance of poisoning the target.

name: Smoke Veil
description: Vanish into a cloud of chakra smoke. Greatly boosts defense for several turns.

name: Wind Slash
description: A razor blade of compressed wind energy. Never misses and deals solid special damage.

name: Dragon Fist
description: A devastating punch that hits like a dragon's jaws. Massive physical damage with a chance to stun.

name: Flame Burst
description: A controlled explosion of pure fire energy. Burns the target, reducing their attack over time.

name: Power Surge
description: Channel raw energy into your muscles. Dramatically increases attack power for several turns.

name: Supernova
description: Ryuu's ultimate technique — a concentrated blast of flame-force energy that obliterates everything in range. Devastatingly powerful but costs almost everything.

name: Iron Guard
description: Reinforce every part of your body with concentrated iron will. Massively boosts defense for an extended duration.

name: Petal Storm
description: A flurry of razor-sharp petals that strikes twice in quick succession. Each hit is moderate but together they shred through defenses.

name: Thorn Barrier
description: Surround yourself with an aura of hardened thorns. Slows the opponent significantly by making every strike cost them momentum.

name: Earth Slam
description: Bring both fists down with tectonic force. Heavy physical damage and a high chance of slowing the target.

name: Thunder Lance
description: A javelin of pure lightning hurled at the opponent. Heavy special damage with a chance of stun from the electrical discharge.

name: Blizzard
description: Unleash a howling blizzard of ice that coats the opponent in frost, dealing damage and drastically reducing their speed.

name: Arcane Surge
description: Flood your core with raw elemental power. Dramatically boosts special attack for several turns.

name: Storm's Eye
description: Sora's signature technique — a focused convergence of all elemental forces into a single devastating strike. The most powerful special attack in the game, at massive energy cost.
